Name: DustBeauty's Seasonal Path and Flooring for Alternative Textures
Author: glymr
Description:
[b][size=4]This mod should work with 1.6. If you encounter a problem with it, please let me know.

NEW UPDATE! [/size][/b]The fabulous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url], who you may remember from their truly excellent [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221]Giant Crops[/url], has helped make new pool and tile textures! Thank you so much, 6480! The new textures were based on DustBeauty's original versions. They are transformative work as allowed by her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]permissions[/url].[b]

IMPORTANT![/b] I have also changed the folders and files around, especially in the Crystal Version, because some of the corners and shadows weren't working correctly. [b]PLEASE DELETE AND INSTALL THE NEW VERSION![/b] Don't just copy over the old version when you update!

~~~

I love DustBeauty's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4852]Seasonal Path and Flooring[/url] mod! Since her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]permissions[/url] allow it, I have converted it to work with the Alternative Textures framework.

There are 3 different versions available for download. They can all be installed together, or you can install just one or two, depending on your play style.
[b]
Basic Version of Dust Beauty's Seasonal Path and Flooring:[/b] This version will work similarly to DustBeauty's original mod.
[list]
[*]Each craftable flooring type has [b]one [/b]new texture available when using the paint can (purchasable from Robin when Alternative Textures is installed).
[*]The gravel path has an additional TILE texture available.
[*]The stone floor has an additional POOL texture available.
[*]The new textures are seasonal, so they will [b]change[/b] in spring, summer, fall, and winter.
[*]The keyword "ChangeSeasons" (Change Seasons) will let you find all seasonal versions of these tiles in the paint can menu.
[/list]
[b]Non-Seasonal [/b][b]Version of Dust Beauty's Seasonal Path and Flooring: [/b]
[list]
[*]Each craftable flooring type will have [b]four[/b] permanent textures available when using the paint can
[*]These textures are for spring, summer, fall, and winter, but [b]do not change[/b] with the seasons.
[*]The gravel path has four additional TILE textures available. 
[*]The stone floor has four additional POOL textures available.
[*]You can place a spring tile that will STAY a spring tile, even in fall or winter.
[*]This is especially useful for decorating inside, where you may not wish the color to change from season to season.
[*]The keyword "NonSeasonal" (Non Seasonal) will let you find all non-seasonal versions of these tiles in the paint can menu.
[/list]
[b]Crystal Version of Dust Beauty's Seasonal Path and Flooring:
[/b][list]
[*]This version makes a secondary version of each of the textures available on the Crystal Path and Crystal Floor types.
[*]"Path" types are available on the Crystal Path. There are [b]five[/b] additional seasonal textures available on the Crystal Path, including the new TILE texture.
[*]"Floor" types are available on the Crystal Floor. There are [b]eight[/b] additional textures available on the Crystal Floor, including the new POOL texture. 
[*]The secondary Crystal Path texture is available on the Stepping Stone texture. 
[*]The secondary Crystal Floor texture itself is available on the Stone Floor texture.
[*]These ARE seasonal, so they will [b]change[/b] in spring, summer, fall, and winter.
[*]The keyword "ChangeSeasons" (Change Seasons) will let you find all seasonal versions of these tiles in the paint can menu.
[*]This pack is most useful installed WITH the Basic version if you want to layer the same paths next to each other. See the pictures for a clearer explanation.
[/list]
You can also use the crystal version alone if you don't like having lots of different textures on each type of flooring, and want them all in one place. Be aware that the game will always adjust the edges of the flooring to match adjacent flooring, so if you try to apply lots of different textures to crystal floor/path only, it may not look right.

All three of these packs can be installed together!

I hope this mod is useful to you. Please endorse it and let me know if you like it. It would make me happy if you would upload images of these textures in use on your farm. <3

Thanks again to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url], who did the pixel art on the pool and tile textures. Please consider commissioning them if you need pixel art. They are great.
